title: Studio session pairing guard + activation helper
description: Final multi-project safety polish before publish. Modify only server/studioRelay.ts, src/components/IdentityBanner.tsx, and tests/workspaceRegistry.test.ts if useful. In Studio Relay identity resolution: when a request omits agent_instance_id, resolve the requested workspace (or default workspace for legacy single-workspace mode). If that workspace has exactly one registered google-ai-studio instance, use/touch that instance automatically instead of creating/using studio-legacy. If the workspace has more than one registered Studio instance, do NOT guess: reject work-claim/progress/result routing with a clear error requiring agent_instance_id, so one Studio tab cannot steal another session's task. Preserve legacy fallback only when zero Studio instances are registered. Keep workspace/project/task binding enforcement unchanged. In the expanded Projects UI, show each Studio session's readable session label plus a small copyable activation instruction containing its workspace_id, project_id, and agent_instance_id so the human can paste one short command into the intended AI Studio tab. Keep the top banner one compact line; do not make the hero larger. Run npm run lint, npm test, npm run build, restart Preview, verify /health, and visually inspect the Projects panel. Submit changed-file artifacts through Studio Relay. Do not Publish.
